targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM slow_digest_daily d JOIN cmdb_cluster c ON c.cluster = d.cluster WHERE d.cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND c.realm IN (${realm:sqlstring}) AND c.tag IN (${tag:sqlstring}) AND d.avg_sec >= ${min_sec} AND d.exec_cnt >= ${min_q} AND d.log_date = '${log_date}'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(d.total_sec)) AS sec FROM slow_digest_daily d JOIN cmdb_cluster c ON c.cluster = d.cluster WHERE d.cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND c.realm IN (${realm:sqlstring}) AND c.tag IN (${tag:sqlstring}) AND d.avg_sec >= ${min_sec} AND d.exec_cnt >= ${min_q} AND d.log_date = '${log_date}'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tuning_ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','REOPENED') AND cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tuning_ticket WHERE status='RESOLVED' AND cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring})

SELECT d.cluster AS 클러스터, c.tag AS 업무, d.qhash AS qhash, d.exec_cnt AS 실행횟수,
                     ROUND(d.total_sec,1) AS 총부하초, ROUND(d.avg_sec,3) AS 평균초, ROUND(d.max_sec,3) AS 최대초,
                     d.rows_examined AS 읽은행수, IFNULL(t.status,'-') AS 티켓, c.owner_team AS 담당팀,
                     LEFT(d.query_text, 120) AS 쿼리
              FROM slow_digest_daily d JOIN cmdb_cluster c ON c.cluster = d.cluster LEFT JOIN tuning_ticket t ON t.cluster=d.cluster AND t.qhash=d.qhash WHERE d.cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND c.realm IN (${realm:sqlstring}) AND c.tag IN (${tag:sqlstring}) AND d.avg_sec >= ${min_sec} AND d.exec_cnt >= ${min_q}
                AND d.log_date = '${log_date}'
              ORDER BY ${sort} DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.log_date) AS time, CONCAT(d.cluster, ' ', LEFT(d.qhash, 8)) AS metric, d.total_sec AS value
              FROM slow_digest_daily d JOIN cmdb_cluster c ON c.cluster = d.cluster WHERE d.cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND c.realm IN (${realm:sqlstring}) AND c.tag IN (${tag:sqlstring}) AND d.avg_sec >= ${min_sec} AND d.exec_cnt >= ${min_q} AND d.log_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL ${days} DAY
                AND d.qhash IN (SELECT qhash FROM (SELECT qhash FROM slow_digest_daily
                  WHERE log_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL ${days} DAY GROUP BY qhash
                  ORDER BY SUM(total_sec) DESC LIMIT 5) x)
              ORDER BY 1

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(log_date) AS time, cluster AS metric, avg_sec AS value
             FROM slow_digest_daily WHERE qhash = '${qhash}'
               AND log_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL ${days} DAY ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.ticket_id AS 번호, t.cluster AS 클러스터, t.qhash, t.status AS 상태, t.owner AS 담당자,
                    ROUND(t.baseline_avg_sec,3) AS 기준평균초,
                    (SELECT ROUND(d.avg_sec,4) FROM slow_digest_daily d WHERE d.cluster = t.cluster AND d.qhash = t.qhash
                       AND d.log_date = '${log_date}') AS 현재평균초,   -- 해결 당시 값이 아니라 선택한 일자 값
                    CASE WHEN t.status = 'RESOLVED' THEN ROUND(100*(1 - t.after_avg_sec / t.baseline_avg_sec)) END AS 개선율, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at,'%m-%d') AS 발행, IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(t.resolved_at,'%m-%d'),'-') AS 해결
             FROM tuning_ticket t WHERE t.cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC

list.name: tag
list.label: 업무
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM cmdb_cluster WHERE realm IN (${realm:sqlstring})

list.name: cluster
list.label: 클러스터
list.query: SELECT cluster FROM cmdb_cluster WHERE realm IN (${realm:sqlstring}) AND tag IN (${tag:sqlstring})

list.name: log_date
list.label: 일자
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(log_date,'%Y-%m-%d') FROM slow_digest_daily ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: qhash
list.label: 쿼리
list.query: SELECT qhash FROM slow_digest_daily WHERE log_date = '${log_date}' ORDER BY total_sec DESC LIMIT 20
